articles.title: Molten: Ropy Flow
articles.summary: Bright orange with tight parallel wavy rope lines running across it, satin sheen with fine sparkle, like combed flow. Reads as a saturated orange car with a fine dark-striped moire texture; the flow curves and pinch points stay visible as soft swirls.
articles.what: Fast pahoehoe: the skin dragged into tight parallel ropes by the flow under it. Up close: Dense fine stripes in bright orange and dark brown that bend into flowing curves, fanning out from a few pinch points like a fingerprint core or wind-blown grass. Stripes are about 4 px wide in most places and 10 px near the pinch points; a visible horizontal seam cuts across the middle of the tile. From a distance: Reads as a saturated orange car with a fine dark-striped moire texture; the flow curves and pinch points stay visible as soft swirls. Measured spec (average): metal 107, roughness 73, coat 68. Shine: satin. Metal: medium. It brings its own colours.

how: Click the zone you want to change.

Plain black or white stripes and number plates: bold shapes over the fine lines

Avoid: numbers over the rope lines, next to other orange finishes.
